selector.rationale: Retroperitoneal fibrosis best explains the findings of a confluent retroperitoneal soft-tissue mass encasing surrounding vessels and bilateral hydronephrosis with extrinsic compression and medial deviation of the ureters, without contradiction.

rejected.label: Cholecystitis
rejected.why: Already treated and not the primary cause of current symptoms

rejected.label: Malignant retroperitoneal tumor
rejected.why: Less specific evidence and lower score compared to Retroperitoneal fibrosis

rejected.label: Ureteral obstruction
rejected.why: Symptom of the underlying disease, not the primary diagnosis

rejected.label: Lymphoma
rejected.why: Although possible, Retroperitoneal fibrosis has a higher score and more specific evidence
